questions: Are these movements involuntary and difficult for you to control?
Are the movements mainly affecting your right arm?
Do you have weakness or numbness on either side of your body?
Have you had difficulty speaking, seeing, walking, or keeping your balance?
Did you lose consciousness or become confused during any episode?
Do the movements occur in rhythmic shaking?
Do they stop when you are asleep?
Do you feel an urge or inner tension before the movement that is relieved afterward?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medication?
Have you used alcohol, recreational drugs, or stimulants recently?
Have you had a similar episode before?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder with functional (psychogenic) tremor

ALTERNATIVE 1: Essential tremor

ALTERNATIVE 2: Focal motor seizure without impaired awareness

ALTERNATIVE 3: Structural movement disorder due to an underlying brain lesion, including parkinsonian or post-stroke tremor
